units: W m^-2 K^-1 (temperatures in K are the keys)
source: Li et al., Nat. Commun. 13, 4901 (2022), doi:10.1038/s41467-022-32600-w, Fig. 1 (measured TDTR thermal boundary conductance). The paper has no source-data file. Values were read off the figure on 2026-11-18 by MV2's hands, a reader who had seen no model output. Readings at 300-700 K were interpolated linearly between neighbouring measured points. Reading uncertainty is about +-5 MW m^-2 K^-1 (about 1.5 %) in G and +-2 % in T. The published error bars are about +-8-10 %. Al/Si uses Sample 1 (the sharper interface).

Al/Si sample 2.note: highest set temperature 600 K; 700 K not measured

Li_G_pp_SI_fig10.note: Phonon-phonon conductance after Li et al. removed their electron-phonon term (Supplementary Fig. 10), read off the figure, +-3 %. The numbers for g and Lambda_p are not stated. G_ep = sqrt(g Lambda_p), with g from Waldecker et al., PRX 6, 021003 (2016) and Lambda_p from Jain and McGaughey, PRB 93, 081206 (2016).

Al_film_total_Lambda_SI_tables_4_6.note: Total thermal conductivity of the Al film used in the TDTR fit (W m^-1 K^-1), not the lattice part
